targets.self_route_adjudication: CONFIRMED. readiness_met=false (ready_seeds 1/3) correctly self-routes to requeue, not a weakens. The two manifest preconditions report met:true only because they are max-over-seeds (max bias_range 0.0035 > floor 0.001; max head_delta 0.25 > 1e-3); the load-bearing readiness gate is a per-seed count requiring >=2 of 3 seeds above the bias-range floor, and only seed 0 clears it. The head trained on all 3 seeds; the FAIL is a cross-candidate-RANGE collapse, not a training failure.

four_layer_diagnosis.claim_alignment: intact -- the experiment never let SD-033b/MECH-263 express. The trained-OFC-head bias carried near-zero cross-candidate range, so the selection-distribution DVs (devaluation shift, task-role separation) are vacuously ~0. non_contributory is correct; a weakens would be a false demotion.
four_layer_diagnosis.biological_reference: clear -- OFC outcome-value coding (Rudebeck & Murray 2018, Stalnaker 2021, Wilson-Niv 2014 cognitive map). The mechanism requires candidate-DIFFERENTIATED value signals. Biology is an existence proof for the class; the failure is a translation/calibration gap, not a falsification.
four_layer_diagnosis.prerequisites: missing/immature -- the candidate-bank cross-candidate z_world spread (ARC-065 GAP-A / SD-056 e2.world_forward action-conditional divergence) is the upstream prerequisite. Reconstruction-shaped P0 training of e2.world_forward fits the action contribution toward zero, so the proposer's world_states[1] bank (the input to compute_bias) is near-uniform across candidates.
four_layer_diagnosis.implementation: partial -- the trained-OFC-head substrate is wired (485d confirmed Delta 0.231) but the behavioural readout starves the range on two axes: (1) the OFC compute_bias clamp (+/-ofc_bias_scale=0.1) saturates on 2/3 seeds; (2) the candidate bank carries no usable cross-candidate spread.
four_layer_diagnosis.environment: adequate -- the SD-054 bipartite reef/forage env supplies the candidate-selection pressure; the env is not the limiter.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: under-instrumented -- the C2 discrimination_separation_ratio is degenerate: between_context_tv ~3e-4 divided by within_context_jitter ~5e-8 yields 322 (or 0 when the denominator is exactly 0). C2 'passed' (n_c2_seeds=2) but criteria_non_degenerate.C2=false flags it as a near-zero-denominator artifact, not real discrimination. The ratio needs an absolute floor on between_context_tv before it can count.
four_layer_diagnosis.integration: isolated -- OFC is deliberately the sole bias channel (gated_policy/dACC/lateral_pfc OFF, modulatory-bias-selection-authority OFF) to avoid confounding the MECH-263 signal. Correct design; not the limiter.
four_layer_diagnosis.scale: adequate -- P1 budget 60 ep trained the head fine (head_delta 0.075-0.25, grad-nonzero 60/1/60). Budget is not the primary cause; the range collapse is structural (clamp + bank), not under-training.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-485e (trained-OFC-head behavioural, SD-033b/MECH-263) FAILed non_contributory via the same-statistic non-vacuity gate: readiness_met=false (1/3 seeds clear the cross-candidate bias-RANGE floor). Autopsy (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-485e_2026-06-11) confirms the self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue: the head trained on all 3 seeds but two gaps starve the cross-candidate range that every MECH-263 behavioural DV requires. (1) OFC compute_bias clamp-saturation on 2/3 seeds (p1_mean_abs_bias ~0.095-0.10 at the +/-ofc_bias_scale=0.1 rail) -- the calibration risk the GAP-8 landing pre-registered. (2) Candidate-bank z_world collapse: the bank is the proposer's reconstruction-trained e2.world_forward world_states[1], which fits the action contribution toward zero (V3-EXQ-571 / ARC-065 GAP-A / SD-056), so even the one unsaturated+READY seed produced a vacuous deval_shift (8e-05 vs 0.05 margin) and a degenerate C2 separation ratio (criteria_non_degenerate.C2=false). NOT a weakens against SD-033b or MECH-263 -- both stay candidate / v3_pending. Requeue as V3-EXQ-485f on BOTH axes (raise ofc_bias_scale and/or add a pre-clamp training signal / 598b REINFORCE-over-candidates seeding; AND enable SD-056 e2_action_contrastive in P0 so the candidate bank carries action-divergent range). Also add an absolute floor on between_context_tv so the C2 separation ratio cannot pass vacuously.

learning_extracted: The GAP-8 landing's pre-registered clamp-saturation risk materialised: at random init the OFC state_bias_head's own Linear bias terms push compute_bias past the +/-ofc_bias_scale rail for ~all candidates on 2/3 seeds, collapsing cross-candidate range to ~0.0005.

Clamp-saturation is necessary but NOT sufficient to explain the FAIL: the one unsaturated+READY seed still produced a vacuous behavioural DV, proving the candidate bank (reconstruction-trained e2.world_forward world_states[1]) carries near-zero cross-candidate z_world spread -- the ARC-065 GAP-A / SD-056 collapse reaches this OFC channel too.

485e is the OFC-head instance of the standing candidate-differentiated-affective-gradients pattern (V3-EXQ-643 / candidate_differentiated_affective_gradients memory): a modulatory channel with magnitude but ~zero cross-candidate range gives E3 no gradient to carve behaviour.

The C2 discrimination_separation_ratio metric is degenerate (between_context_tv / within_context_jitter with ~0 denominators -> 322 or 0); it 'passed' but criteria_non_degenerate.C2=false caught it. A future version needs an absolute floor on between_context_tv before the ratio can count as a PASS.
The same-statistic non-vacuity readiness gate worked exactly as designed: it converted what would have been a false SD-033b/MECH-263 weakens into a correct substrate_not_ready_requeue.
